mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the CPIAUCSL inflation rate above 0.5 percentage points over three months signals rising inflation pressures, prompting monetary tightening expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL rise >0.5pp in 3 months), or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A tight labor market (low unemployment rate) combined with strong consumer spending (high retail sales) signals robust economic growth and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term between UNRATE and RSAFS has a negative coefficient in a regression of 20-day returns, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion characterized by strong GDP growth (GDPC1 YoY > 3.0%) and elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%), the S&P 500 exhibits negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to overvaluation and potential monetary tightening.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods meeting the late-cycle expansion regime condition, or the Rank IC for the regime condition is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production indicates stronger economic activity and corporate output, supporting equity valuations and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between INDPRO and 5-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 4.5% signals economic weakness and recession risks, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (UNRATE rise >0.3pp in 3 months), or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing market activity (HOUST above 1300k units) combined with robust retail sales (RSAFS above 700k million dollars) signals a healthy consumer economy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term between HOUST and RSAFS has a negative coefficient in a regression of 20-day returns, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1300.0 thousand units signals weakening consumer demand and economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (HOUST < 1300.0), or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
